Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by the claimant on this one, if that's okay. I'm not comfortable giving my full name on tape yet.
Q: That's fine for now. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road hedaing toward a shopping center. It was around midday and the traffic was light.
Q: Can you walk me through what happened right before impact?
A: The other car drifted into my lane as it came around a curve. I braked and steered right, but we still met nose to
nose. It wasn't a hard hit, more like a jolt, but the setabelt grabbed me hard across the shoulder.
Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway, and did airbags deploy?
A: No, neither car left the road. The airbags didn't go off. Both cars were drivable at first, though the front ends were
pushed in.
Q: Where do you feel injured now?
A: My right shoulder. It's sore when I raise my arm above my head, and I've had some stiffness in the neck since
then. I saw a doctor the same afternoon and they gave me a sling and some medication.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with that shoulder or neck?
A: I had some soreness a couple of years ago from lifting boxes at work, but it resolved and I hadn't been treated for it
since.
Q: Thank you. Is there anytihng you'd like to add before we finish?
A: Just that I'm trying to get my treatment going and I'd appreciate a prompt response. That's all I have.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>
